This is the high-tech one. It shoots X-rays into the metal and reads the exact composition.

This tests how electricity moves through the metal.

snippet.title: Electoral Regimes of the World 2026 🗳️ #Democracy #Education #Politics #CivilLiberties
snippet.description:
This video outlines how countries are classified in 2026 using the Regimes of the World framework. It distinguishes four electoral regimes based on election quality, civil liberties, and constraints on executive power.
- Closed autocracy: citizens cannot choose the executive or legislature through multiparty elections.
- Electoral autocracy: multiparty elections exist, but freedoms of association and expression are too limited for free and fair contests.
- Electoral democracy: citizens choose the executive and legislature in meaningful, free and fair, multiparty elections.
- Liberal democracy: electoral democracy with protected individual and minority rights, equality before the law, and effective checks on the executive.

This video outlines how countries are classified in 2026 using the Regimes of the World framework. It distinguishes four electoral regimes based on election quality, civil liberties, and constraints on executive power.
- Closed autocracy: citizens cannot choose the executive or legislature through multiparty elections.
- Electoral autocracy: multiparty elections exist, but freedoms of association and expression are too limited for free and fair contests.
- Electoral democracy: citizens choose the executive and legislature in meaningful, free and fair, multiparty elections.
- Liberal democracy: electoral democracy with protected individual and minority rights, equality before the law, and effective checks on the executive.

#ElectoralRegimes #Autocracy #Electoral #RuleOfLaw
